title: Gavin Lake Demonstration Area AAC and 2001-2005 harvest comparison
source_document: Alex Fraser Research Forest Management and Working Plan #3 (January 1, 2007)
notes: GL is the Gavin Lake Demonstration Area working circle, not the whole Gavin Lake block.
Table 34 net area is 532 ha; net harvest land base is 478 ha after 8% WTP and 2% research reductions.
The GL cutting cycle in Table 34 is 100 years; the legacy Gavin matrix uses an 80-year clearcut rotation on a 4,662.96 ha THLB proxy.
The actual 2001-2005 values are averages; the AAC values are the plan targets.
Table 36 total Gavin (132.7 / 74.4 ha/yr) includes BV, GL and TP, not GL alone. Do not use that total as a GL benchmark.
This is a public management-plan benchmark, not the legacy Patchworks scenario intent.
